title: Purple Line Maintenance Block - May 13
body: BMRCL announces a one-day maintenance block on the Purple Line (Baiyappanahalli-Mysuru Road) on Tuesday, May 13, 2025. Services will be suspended from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Passengers are advised to use alternate routes.

title: BBMP Circular: Single-Use Plastic Ban in Food Establishments
body: BBMP has issued a circular prohibiting the use of single-use plastic cups, plates, and cutlery in all cafes, restaurants, and food stalls within BBMP limits effective June 1, 2025. Violators will be fined INR 5,000 per instance.

title: BWSSB Water Supply Disruption - Koramangala, HSR Layout
body: BWSSB announces a 24-hour water supply disruption in Koramangala and HSR Layout on May 9, 2025 due to emergency pipeline repair. Supply will resume by May 10 morning.

title: BESCOM Scheduled Power Interruption in Jayanagar
body: BESCOM announces a scheduled power interruption in Jayanagar on June 2, 2025 from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM for transformer maintenance. Residents are advised to unplug appliances and use emergency lighting if necessary.

title: BBMP Composting Initiative for Residential Wards
body: BBMP launches a door-to-door composting initiative across five residential wards starting July 1, 2025. Residents will receive compost bins and training to reduce organic waste sent to landfills.

title: The Hindu: Traffic Diversion on Kengeri Road for Repair Work
body: The Hindu reports that traffic on Kengeri Road will be diverted for two days due to urgent repair work on the bridge. Commuters are advised to use Outer Ring Road and NICE Road during peak hours.
